degree.text: Degree Awarded: Bachelor’s Degree in Management"

description.text: "This program is to cultivate students to master basic theory and knowledge of tourism management subjects, know the development in tourism, aquire the ability of analyzing and settling problems by utilizing tourism management theory and be qualified for careers in tourism administration departments at all leves, tourism enterprizes and tourism institutions.Major Courses: Management, Micro-economics, Macro-economics, Accounting, Management Information System, Statistics, Financial Management, Marketing Management, Economic Law, Brief Introduction of Tourism, Tourism Economics, Hotel Management Principle, Tourism Resources and Their Development, etc.Degree Awarded: Bachelor’s Degree in Management"

duration.text: The Tourism Management at Beijing International Studies University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) Scanned copy of the first page of passport (valid later than September 2025); 2) Notarized certificate of the highest degree. If the applicant is a current student, they must provide the pre-graduation certificate issued by their school. Notarized Chinese or English translation shall be attached to any text other than Chinese and English. 3) Academic transcipts. Applicants for bachelor degree must submit scanned copy of their high school transcipt; applicants for master’s degree must submit scanned copy of study transcript. Transcipts in languages other than Chinese or English, must be accompanied by a notarized Chinese or English translation. 4) Scanned copies of Chinese and English proficiency 3 certificates; Note: Applicants who intend to study in Chinese must submit an HSK level 5 certificate. Those who have already completed a degree taught in Chinese are exempt from this requirement. Applicants who intend to study in English must provide an IELTS score of 6.0 or equivalent, or a TOEFL score of 85 or equivalent. Applicants from English-speaking countries or those whose previous degree program was taught in English are exempt from providing proof of English language proficiency. 5) Recommendation letters. Applicants for master’s degree must submit letters of recommendation from 2 associate professors or above; 6) Study plan (more than 1000 words, written in Chinese or English); 7) Physical examination records for foreigners (refer to Appendix 1, the template must be filled in English and the examination results are valid for 6 months); 8) Proof of no criminal record (supporting documents within 6 months before the application date).

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens from Belt and Road countries and hold a valid ordinary passport. 2. Applicants for bachelor degree must be no more than 25 years old; applicants for master degree must be no more than 35 years old. 3. Applicants for bachelor degree should have a high school diploma or equivalent qualifications, with excellent academic performance; applicants for master’s degree should have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualifications, with excellent academic performance. 5. Applicants must be in good health. 6. Applicants must have no violation of discipline, no public security punishment, no criminal behavior or record, friendly to China, have good conduct, abide by Chinese laws and regulations of the university, and respect Chinese people's customs and habits. 7. Meet other requirements specified in the International Student Enrollment Manual of Beijing International Studies University.
